svg.title: Open-source components used in ESG Evidence Navigator
svg.desc: Top row is the implemented Dense RAG path: PyMuPDF extracts public PDF pages. multilingual-E5-small encodes document chunks in advance and the question at query time. NumPy ranks stored normalized vectors by cosine similarity. Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct reads the top three retrieved snippets and generates an answer with source IDs. The separate bottom row lists shared runtime and ecosystem dependencies: Python, PyTorch, Hugging Face libraries (SentenceTransformers, Transformers, huggingface-hub). Bottom-row adjacency does not imply a dataflow edge. Personal local PoC, not a DORCO deployment.
